paper_title: Leading Axion-Photon Sensitivity with NuSTAR Observations of M82 and M87
suggested_experiment_name: NuSTAR M82/M87 stellar axion search (Ning & Safdi 2024)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, 95% CL upper limit as plotted on y-axis
notes: Astrophysical (non-DM) search: stellar Primakoff axion production in M82/M87 with conversion to hard X-rays in galactic/cluster magnetic fields, observed with NuSTAR. Headline 95% CL power-constrained limit |g_agamma| < 6.4e-13 GeV^-1 (M82) for m_a <~ 1e-10 eV, encoded as a flat bound over the low-mass plateau shown in Fig. 2 (plot spans 1e-13 to 1e-9 eV; limit degrades above ~1e-10 eV, but no numerical mass-dependence is tabulated). M87 gives a weaker limit of 8.4e-13 GeV^-1 (not included).
